messages:
deploy-bot: 🔔 Staging deploy started — env=staging, change window=22:00-23:00 UTC, commit=`3a1f9b2f`, tag=`release/v0.12.4`, initiated by @sam

sam: Kicking off rollout. monitoring smoke + latency. @maria can you run the canary probes? :eyes:

maria: On it, starting smoke harness in ~2m. will post results here.

devon: Noted runtime pin: `infer-runtime=aurora-v2` for this rollout.

ci-bot: CI pipeline green — unit, integration, e2e passed. perf benchmarks within tolerance.

deploy-bot: Canary shifted to 10% -> 50% over 8m. KV cache warming in progress. streaming logs: https://internal.ci/log/3a1f9b2f

maria: Smoke probe results (curl against /health):
```
$ curl -sS -D - https://staging.api.redwood.dev/health -o /dev/null
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
{"status":"ok","uptime":10234}
```
All endpoints look good on canary instances. latency p95 ~120ms.

ops-bot: :warning: Observability alert — reranker service returned intermittent 504s from canary nodes at 50% traffic (3 occurrences in 2m). Auto-hold policy threshold=3 triggered.

sam: Holding traffic and pausing the rollout. checking logs. tagging note: hold_reason=reranker-504s

maria: Attaching minimal stacktrace excerpt from canary logs:
```
2025-11-02T22:12:10Z ERROR reranker: downstream timeout (net/http: request canceled) trace_id=tx-9b1c
at reranker.go:142
```
Devon: Could be a backend timeout regression — confirm backend pool sizes on canary nodes. I'm looking.

sam: Given auto-hold and repeat 504s, I recommend rolling back canary to previous stable commit. initiating canary rollback now.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to previous commit `2f7d3a8e`. Rolling back canary subset only.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed — canary instances reverted to `2f7d3a8e`. Canary traffic restored to pre-deploy baseline. Full deploy aborted.

sam: Filing follow-up ticket #1234 for reranker investigation and root-cause analysis. Will re-run deploy once fix merged. :memo: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Staging deploy finished (status=aborted). duration=10m20s. reason=canary reranker 504s triggered auto-hold. artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/release/v0.12.4/3a1f9b2f. release-notes-draft: https://docs.internal/releases/draft-v0.12.4

maria: Thanks — will add smoke logs and timestamps to the ticket.

devon: ACK. Leaving runtime pin unchanged.

ci-bot: Notifying release-candidates channel of aborted deploy.

deploy-bot: If you want to retry in the same change window, respond `@deploy-bot retry` after fixes.
